title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E14 — Everybody Hates Gretzky
In an attempt to keep his younger brother, Drew, out of further trouble, Chris reluctantly agrees to skip school and accompany Drew on a mission to find his idol, hockey great Wayne Gretzky.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E15 — Everybody Hates The BFD
Chris is so desperate to raise the funds to go to a Run DMC concert that he jumps at the chance to participate in Mr. Omar's Black Funeral Directors' (BFD) scholarship fund.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E16 — Everybody Hates Being Cool
On a mission to become one of the 'cool' kids, Chris is caught with cigarettes and suspended from school.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E1 — Goop - Hair-It-Is
Shawn's new hair care product makes a big impression during a live commercial. GARRETT MORRIS and GARY COLEMAN guest star as themselves.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E2 — First Class
When Marlon is mistaken for athlete John Starkes, he ends up with Starkes' first class airplane tickets.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E3 — I'm Too Sexy for My Brother
When Marlon decides to go into modeling, Shawn wants a piece of the action too.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E4 — Free Wally
Marlon's pesky interference in Shawn and Lisa's relationship causes the couple a lot of tension. Marlon tries to correct the situation by sending them on a romantic ferry ride together.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E5 — My Fair Marlon
Shawn helps Marlon woo a sophisticated woman, but complications develop when she gets suspicious.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E6 — Pops Moves In
When Pops moves in with Shawn and Marlon, it's just like when they were kids--a little too much so.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E7 — Afro Cab
Shawn and Marlon start their own taxi company but soon find a few roadblocks to success.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E8 — The Shawn Shank Redemption
When Shawn and Marlon buy an expensive piece of jewelry instead of paying their outstanding traffic tickets, big trouble follows.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E9 — ER
Marlon pretends to be Shawn to get treated at the hospital, but the plan becomes complicated when the doctor turns out to be Lisa's father, who is anxious to meet Shawn.  RICHARD ROUNDTREE guest stars as Dr. Saunders.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E10 — The Poppa-Cabana
Pops takes a vacation in Atlantic City, but leaving the diner in Marlon's care is an even bigger gamble.  GARRETT MORRIS guest stars as Uncle Leon.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E11 — It's Shawn! It's Marlon! It's Superboys!
Shawn and Marlon get unexpected results when they complain to their obnoxious landlord (SHERMAN HEMSLEY - "The Jeffersons").

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E12 — Pulp Marlon
Marlon's got a sexy new girlfriend--but she's got a dangerous secret that gets him and Shawn in big trouble.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S1 E13 — Brazilla vs. Rodney
When Shawn and Marlon start a children's entertainment business, they meet some tough competition.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E1 — Shawn Takes a New Stand
Shawn buys the building's newsstand and hires Marlon, with disastrous results.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E2 — Fatal Subtraction
Shawn finds his perfect woman, but Marlon tries to convince him that she's not what she seems.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E3 — Blood Is Thicker than Watercolor
Marlon gets discovered by an art patron and creates his own unique paintings.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E4 — Two Men and a Baby
Shawn and Marlon find a baby on their doorstep--and one of them might be its father!

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E5 — Loot
Everyone wants to split the huge stash of money they find in the building, but the owner may still come get it.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E6 — The Liar's Club
Marlon gets jealous when Monique pretends to be married to Shawn to impress her competitive ex-boyfriend.

title: The Wayans Bros.
description:
S2 E7 — Scared Straight
Shawn and Marlon play a Halloween prank on Pops, but when terrible things begin to happen around the building, they wonder if they offended an evil spirit.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S2 E20 — Ring Around the Piggy
Steve fears he will lose Regina forever when he is invited to Warrington's house for an announcement.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S2 E21 — The He Man, Player-Haters-Club
Steve and Cedric (Steve Harvey, Cedric "The Entertainer") take Regina and Lovita (Wendy Raquel Robinson, Terri J. Vaughn) to casino night at the Onyx Club in Chicago.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S2 E22 — That's a Bunch of Bull, Ced
Cedric and Steve (Cedric "The Entertainer," Steve Harvey) get choice tickets for Game 7 of the NBA finals, but there is a catch.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E1 — Back to School
Musician Steve Hightower becomes an inner-city music teacher.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E2 — Dead Dog Walking
When Bullethead (William Lee Scott) gets arrested, Steve (Steve Harvey) finds out that being a teacher doesn't end at 5 p.m.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E3 — Mr. Hightower's Opus
Steve (Steve Harvey) accepts a bet from Regina (Wendy Raquel Robinson) to organize a band before the school banquet.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E4 — The Rock
Sara and Romeo (Nefta Perry, Merlin Santana) are caught in a closet together; Cedric (Cedric "The Entertainer") campaigns to win "Teacher of the Month." With Steve Harvey.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E5 — Brush With Greatness
Romeo (Merlin Santana) uses Sophia's (Tracy Vilar) painting to win first place in an art contest; Cedric (Cedric "The Entertainer") goes on a shopping spree.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E6 — Loose Lips Sink Relationships
Romeo (Merlin Santana) insults Sophia (Tracy Vilar) and then scrambles to make amends before he can make romance at the dance. With Steve Harvey.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E7 — Papa Don't Take No Mess
Romeo (Merlin Santana) must learn how to stand up to his father (Hector Maisonette); a mouse invades Steve and Cedric's (Steve Harvey, Cedric "The Entertainer") apartment.

title: The Steve Harvey Show
description:
S1 E8 — The Plays Not the Thing
Sophia wins the role of Juliet in her school's production of "Romeo and Juliet," but Romeo is not chosen to play opposite her.

title: Martin
description:
S1 E9 — The Parents Are Coming..
Following Martin's advice, Cole stands up to his mother, but finds himself moving in with Martin after his mum kicked him out.
